cards.title: What Parents Get Wrong About Children's Lies
cards.body: Children's dishonesty is often misunderstood by parents who assume it reflects character flaws. Research reveals five common misconceptions about why kids lie and what it actually means for their development.

cards.title: How Nature and Nurture Drive Intergenerational Trauma
cards.body: Trauma isn't just psychological—research shows trauma-altered genes can be passed down through generations. Understanding this complex cycle helps parents break harmful patterns in their families.

cards.title: Greg Wise on Failed IVF and Grief
cards.body: The actor opens up about the emotional toll of unsuccessful fertility treatment and how it shook his identity as a man. Two decades later, he reflects on the lasting pain of that experience.

cards.title: Single Mum Budgets £40 Weekly Shop
cards.body: A single mother shares her tight budget constraints and what she hopes for in policy changes. Her story highlights the financial pressures facing low-income families.

cards.title: Parents Who Killed Baby Get Sentences Increased
cards.body: Klevi and Nivalda Pirjani's sentences were increased after murdering their baby Miguel in 2024. The case underscores child protection failures within the family system.
